risk_summary: The excerpt is relatively transparent and highly quantified, with clear explanations of earnings changes, operating costs, fuel-hedge mark-to-market losses, fleet restructuring, and pension funding. Risk is moderated by substantial forward-looking language around expected efficiency gains, demand, network performance, and future restructuring charges, including estimated charges of $50 million to $150 million. Overall tone is cautiously confident, although fuel-price volatility, international demand weakness, pension obligations, and execution risks remain material.
